Remark
[asymptotics of the Hessian of $r$]

Source: petersen:page-0211 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-normal-coords-first-order Writing the metric in polar form $g=dr^2+g_r$ (restriction of $g$ to the level spheres of $r$) near $p$, and comparing with the Euclidean $\delta _{ij}=dr^2+r^2ds_{n-1}^2$, first-order agreement (subsection 5.3) gives $\lim _{r\to 0}g_r=0$ and $\lim _{r\to 0}\big(\partial _rg_r-\partial _r(r^2ds_{n-1}^2)\big)=0$. Since $\partial _rg_r=2\operatorname {Hess}r$, this yields $\lim _{r\to 0}\big(\operatorname {Hess}r-\tfrac 1rg_r\big)=0$.
